description:
Replace the inline `json!` list bodies of six commands with typed list envelopes declared as their output schemas, and fix the schema key that hides `graph rdeps`.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/schema.rs` maps commands to output schemas and falls back to `(None, "CommandResponse")` (`:730`) for unregistered ones. `ListEnvelope<K, T, E>` (`crates/jit/src/output.rs`, `crates/jit/src/domain/list_envelope.rs`) derives `count` from its collection and has a manual `JsonSchema`. A command whose JSON carries `count` beside a collection under the fallback is invisible to a schema-driven list check.

Six commands build `count` beside a collection as inline `json!` in `crates/jit/src/main.rs`: `gate preset list` (`:4547`), `events tail` (`:4984`), `events query` (`:5005`), `label values` (`:5900`), `claim status` (`:7391`) and `claim list` (`:7476`). `graph rdeps` emits `GraphDownstreamResponse`, but `schema.rs:668` registers it under the key `graph_downstream`, so its schema falls back.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of the six commands emits a `ListEnvelope` instantiation declared as its output schema, and no inline `json!` body in `main.rs` carries a `count` key.
- [hard] REQ-02: `graph rdeps` declares `GraphDownstreamResponse` as its output schema.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each command's JSON output is unchanged apart from field order.
- [hard] REQ-04: MCP tool generation and its unit tests pass against the regenerated schema.
title: Inline list bodies in main.rs become typed list envelopes
